name: Costa Coffee
source_title: Costa Coffee UK menu pages: Nutritional Information (UK) and Allergens Information (UK) (read 2026-10-09, no date shown)
sites_evidence: NOT FOUND: none of Costa's own pages read (home, menu, history, sustainability, store locator) prints a store count. Founder to supply a number from a Costa page before import; the importer stops at 0.
allergen_guide_title: Costa Coffee allergen and nutritional information guide (PDF)
note: Per portion as printed on each product page. Food pages print one portion; drink pages print the default selection only (usually Medium, semi-skimmed or whole milk, Signature blend, no extras) in an In store column and a Take-Out column, both kept as separate rows where the numbers differ. Other sizes, milks, syrups and shots change the numbers and were not read. Allergens: 'Yes' on the page = contains, 'C' = may contain (cross-contamination risk). Costa's own disclaimer says no product is free from allergens.
